requested_items.title: Exact-partial temporal/finalizer bounded 12 ns physical calibration
requested_items.objective: Run one 12 ns Nangate45 macro-mode point for divider_lanes 1, 2, 4, and 8.
requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require exactly one status=ok row per design, CLOCK_PERIOD=12ns, critical_path_ns<=12ns, exactly 104 fakeram45_64x32 instances, no missing blackboxes, the checked deterministic 104-SRAM placement, and no generic /16777215 operator. Treat total_power_mw as generic OpenROAD physical power only.
requested_items.notes: The prior lane1 6ns routed checkpoint measured critical_path_ns=9.3036, instance_area_um2=394956, total_power_mw=0.0605, and 104 macros after 3769.82 seconds. The first bounded run then measured a timing-feasible lane1 12ns row (critical_path_ns=11.6726, instance_area_um2=378084, total_power_mw=0.0364) while lanes2/4/8 failed in RTLMP macro clustering. The retry reuses the successful lane1 104-SRAM placement across all lane variants so only lane-specific logic changes.
